notes.title: 1.0.5.86 is OUT!! New dithering algorithms added!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/d0d5bc4da81f8f98914ce5ceb876030486258101.png[/img]
New effect added : [b]Dithering & Halftoning[/b]

With this new effect, new dithering algorithms have been added that were not previously available in PixageFX.

Ordered dithering algorithms have been diversified and additionally
- Floyd Steinberg
- Stucky
- Sierra3, two rows of Sierra and Sierra lite
- Jujini
- Added Burkes algorithms.
We reconsidered the existing ordered dithering algorithms. We've added more options for Bayer and also added some halftoning patterns.

[i]Important note: Currently, Pixelate effects still contain old dithering methods. New dithering algorithms will be added to all pixelization effects when we are completely sure from user feedback and testing.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/dada9ee7be30a097db0224193fd9a96e87160249.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.0.4.6 is out!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/5b4728561d9c53a85a627f55087cf3d7cf4f317c.png[/img]

In this version, we have made changes in two effects. 

* The [b]Crop effect[/b] which previously only worked on percentages, now works with both percent and pixel modes. In Pixel mode, you can write exactly the output size you want in pixels.

* We also improved the [b]Resize Canvas[/b] (formerly Extend Canvas) effect so that  you can exactly set the outputsize in pixels.

Two new effects ([b]Alpha Threshold[/b] and [b]Color Counter[/b]) and a new category ([b]Info[/b]) have been added.

* [b]Alpha Threshold:[/b] With this effect, you can set an alpha pixel to a fixed value to the lower and upper values of a certain threshold value. For example, you can clear (or set them to zero) all alpha pixels which have values below 255.

* [b]Color Counter:[/b] This is a new [b]'info category'[/b] effect that calculates exactly how many unique colors are in your pixel art image. Thus, you will be able to get the number of colors in the image at any stage you want.

notes.title: 1.0.4.4 RELEASE! New LOOKUPTABLE (LUT) Effect
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/d42d024fa3304aa2104991e14ec7e3640a37b0e8.png[/img]

With new LUT effect, you will now be able to use CUBE extension LookUpTable files.

Unfortunately there are some limitations on this effect.
* Cannot currently process CUBE files above LUT_3D_SIZE 33 (For example cannot process LUT_3D_SIZE 64)
* If there are some unclamped values in the CUBE file, undesirable results may occur.

However, we will improve this effect and remove limitations as well.

notes.title: 1.0.4.0 Released!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/252bb7d4864d9e4b586efc8885ed53524c4a17a3.png[/img]

[i]We know we haven't been updating for a while. But with this new version, we fixed many bugs and added new features we think you will like.[/i]

[b]What's new and fixes in this major update?[/b]

[b]BETTER PERFORMANCE & LESS BUGS :[/b]

* First of all, Pixel Art Workshop was completely 64 bit. In this way, problems with system memory have been resolved.

* User interface and effect processing is faster.

* Many of the crash problems have been solved

[b]NEW FEATURES :[/b]

* VIDEO EXPORT : Now you can create mp4 files directly with Pixel Art Workshop!

* VIDEO IMPORT :  In the video import you can see the original FPS of the video.

* DRAG & DROP FILES : You can drag and drop PNG, JPG, GIF and MP4 files into Pixel Art Workshop.

* DRAG & DROP PROJECTS : You can drag and drop project files (.pawproject) extension into Pixel Art Workshop.

* EFFECT PARAMETER UNDO / REDO 

* BETTER 'ADD EFFECTS' WINDOW : You will now see predefined thumbnails showing what the effects do.

* FAVORITES for ADD EFFECTS & IMAGE LIBRARY WINDOWS : You can add the effects or library images you use frequently to your favorites.

* PREFERENCES - FPS SETTING : You can get a smoother interface by increasing the FPS value of the application. (May increase CPU and GPU usage). 

That's all for now. Please continue to share bugs you found and ideas with us.

notes.title: A letter from the creator and our short-term roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/dcf5ebf40c5633981d10b1d275a027f5566fee94.png[/img]

First of all, the intense interest we experienced in a short time made us very amused. Thanks for  your huge interest, feedbacks and positive/negative ratings ...
Feedbacks and ratings are very important for us so we intend to meet your all requests step by step.
In this direction, the road map ahead will be like as following;
- Our first priority is to fix some high CPU/GPU usage issues  and  minor bugs as soon as possible.
- Adding movie export feature. By this way, you will now be able to export movies directly from Pixel Art Workshop.
- Bringing Drag & Drop feature. You will be able to drag & drop one or more images directly.

Thanks again for your patience and attention. Please keep on letting us know of any suggestions and feedbacks.


(Event image created with Pixel Art Workshop. Original image from pixabay : https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2016/03/31/20/33/head-1295862_960_720.png )

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 is ready!
notes.content:
The most important update in this version is that video import problems such as freezing and skipping are now fixed. Also, video import is now much faster (Use fast mode).
Another added feature is the ability to import animated GIF images, so you can import GIF animations like video files.

Also fixed the inverted edge selection bug.

Known bugs:
- In some long-running processes (such as the Mean Shift effect) the program can go into an infinite loop. The only way to fix this right now is to delete that effect. It will be fixed as soon as possible.
- Unable to save visited folders and main configuration file.(Will be fixed in next version)

New feature:
- GIF Animation import.

Features to be added soon:
- Thresholding and smoothing will be added to Laplace and Highpass effects, thus making these effects more usable.
- Mp4 video export feature will be added.
- Layer feature will be added. Thus, it will be possible to work with more than one source image.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/127076c56b454f2169dd3c3dafbd5e41415bff12.png[/img]

notes.title: Pixel Art Workshop 1.0.2 Released
notes.content:
Release notes:
Known bugs:
- Some video formats may experience skipping and freezing. This is a known bug and will be fixed in future versions.
- Inverted edge option in selection modes makes alpha completely black in transparent images.
- In some long-running processes (such as the Mean Shift effect) the program can go into an infinite loop. The only way to fix this right now is to delete that effect. It will be fixed as soon as possible.
- Remembering the last entered folders feature may not work in some cases.

Newly Added features:
- Pixelate Advanced 2: Helps you get more consistent results.
- Remove Antialias: Cleans antialiased pixels and gives more pixelart-like and sharp results.

Features to be added soon:
- Thresholding and smoothing will be added to Laplace and Highpass effects, thus making these effects more usable.
- Mp4 video export feature will be added.
- Layer feature will be added. Thus, it will be possible to work with more than one source image.
